sentences.text: This matter is taken up by hybrid mode.

03. 2. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3.
The petitioners have filed this writ petition challenging the notice of eviction issued U/S. 12 of the Coal Bearing Areas (Acquisition & Development) Act, 1957.

4. Mr. S. Sahoo, learned counsel for the petitioners contended that the land of the petitioners has been acquired and the compensation amount has been paid, but so far as the structure standing thereon is concerned, no compensation amount has been paid and on the other hand, notice of eviction has been issued.
5. Since notice of eviction has been issued against the petitioners, it is open to the petitioners to approach the authority concerned by ventilating the aforesaid grievance and on receipt of such grievance, the authority concerned shall take necessary steps in accordance with law.
6. With this aforesaid observation, the writ petition stands disposed of.
